correctness.rationale: For trace (unnormalized) symmetric-power SU(3) characters and probability Haar, Pieri gives |chi_m|^2=sum_{i=0}^m chi_(i,i). The Bégin–Mathieu–Walton general SU(3) triple tensor multiplicity specializes to N(i,j,k)=max(0,1+min(i,j,k,i+j-k,i+k-j,j+k-i)); the slack h decomposition counts triangle triples. Summing non-overlapping forbidden triangles yields Δ=(r+1)^2(m-r+1)+C(r+1,3) for 0<=r<=m, and counting a+b>=r-h yields C(2m-r+3,3) for m<=r<=2m, zero later. The piecewise boundary agrees. Exact sums yield the saturated and diagonal moments. The first difference is a concave quadratic with root t_m, proving peak location; second branch decreases. Independent direct integer multiplicity summation corroborated 320 pairs (m,r) with m<=15, and both finite sums for m=0..15; these finite checks are ancillary to the all-integer proof. Published 1992 multiplicity formula is a mathematical input.
